nodes.label: ADR-0003 Graph decides scope; LLM decides action
Decision: graph decides scope, LLM decides action
nodes.rationale: Check-everything costs one LLM call per memory per change and LLM-chosen scope is non-deterministic and untestable. Embedding-similarity scoping misses non-textual dependents (CGPA to eligibility). Quality is bounded by link recall, so missed-link rate is measured. Revisit if link recall stays below target after Phase 4.
